WITH school_inf AS (
  SELECT 
    "School Code",
    "Block",
    CASE WHEN "Electricity" = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_electricity
  FROM "school_infrastructure"
),
enrolment AS (
  SELECT 
    "School Code",
    "Block",
    "Girls 2024" + "Boys 2024" AS total_2024
  FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
)
SELECT 
  s."Block",
  COUNT(*) AS schools_without_electricity,
  SUM(e.total_2024) AS total_2024_enrolment
FROM school_inf s
JOIN enrolment e ON s."School Code" = e."School Code"
WHERE s.no_electricity = 1
GROUP BY s."Block";
